value.summary: 3-bot parallel execution: (A) fixed all pylint warnings in consolidate_single_inventory.py — renamed shadowed vars, UPPER_CASE constants, removed dead code; (B) created .github/workflows/ci-tests.yml with TS lint/type-check/test:ci + Python pylint gate; (C) added smoke test step to deploy-vercel.yml for client/production. All committed and pushed to main.
